subject: PO and invoicing rhythm — PO number on invoices, consolidated billing, and conditional discount bands
messages:
From: Sara Holt <sara.holt@amerimedical.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: David Lin <david.lin@amerimedical.com>
Date: 2027-02-20T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: PO template + invoicing cadence questions

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the call earlier — very helpful. A couple of procurement items we need to lock before we can issue a standing PO:

- PO number must appear on each individual invoice (our AP system rejects invoices without the PO on the invoice header).
- We prefer a consolidated monthly invoice per PO (AmeriMedical policy). Weekly invoices create too much overhead.
- Net60 is our default for large vendors — we expect net60 on annual contracts unless otherwise negotiated.
- Can you accept separate invoices for separate PO lines (we sometimes split by BU)? Fine if invoices reference the same PO number.

I attached our PO spreadsheet (AmeriMedical_PO_spec_template.xlsx) for your billing team to review. Also, our finance team asks whether Redwood offers early-payment discounts or a billing-credit if we commit to an annual pre-pay.

Next steps: can you confirm whether Redwood can: 1) show the PO number on every invoice, 2) provide consolidated monthly invoices (one per PO), and 3) confirm Net60 or provide an alternative plus any discount for early payment?

If we can get agreement this week, I can circulate the PO to legal and expedite approvals.

Thanks,
Sara
Procurement Manager
AmeriMedical Systems

Attachments: AmeriMedical_PO_spec_template.xlsx

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sara Holt <sara.holt@amerimedical.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-20T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PO template + invoicing cadence questions

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear list and the template. Looping in Marissa (sales lead) and Karthik (finance/legal) to confirm on the internal constraints.

Short answers up front:
- PO number on each invoice: yes — we can include the PO number in the invoice header.
- Consolidated monthly invoices: we can provide a single monthly invoice per PO if the PO maps to a single billing entity and product set. We have to confirm on multi-BU split behavior (see below).
- Net60 request: our standard term for enterprise is Net45. Net60 is possible but requires one of the following: (a) an annual prepay (credit applied) or (b) enrollment in our invoice guarantee program (requires a small processing fee).

Proposed compromise (to move things fast):
1) Redwood provides consolidated monthly invoices per PO for the primary billing entity. If AmeriMedical needs separate invoices per BU, we can emit multiple line-item invoices referencing the same PO but they will be grouped in a monthly statement for reconciliation.
2) Net45 standard, or Net60 with a 2% processing fee OR 1.5% discount if AmeriMedical prepays at least 6 months upfront.
3) We will make sure the PO number and your internal PO fields appear in the invoice XML (for automatic ingestion).

Marissa / Karthik: any objections to the Net45 / Net60+fee or prepay discount approach? Also tagging finance for revenue recognition check if the prepay discount needs a specific ARR treatment.

If this sounds OK, I can update the draft SOW and send a DocuSign link for signatures.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Sr. Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment references: AMED asked for PO template (received).

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Sara Holt <sara.holt@amerimedical.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-21T08:35:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PO template + invoicing cadence questions

Thanks — quick notes from sales/legal perspective:

- Sales: Marissa here. We want to avoid a Net60 by default because that materially delays cash on a mid-seven-figure ARR deal. The 1.5% prepay discount for 6 months (or 5% for full annual prepay) is acceptable to offer.

- Legal/Contract: we can accept consolidated monthly statements. However, we need "one invoice per payment claim" on Redwood side for our internal audit; grouping in a monthly statement is fine as long as the monthly statement lists invoice numbers and the PO is on each invoice. That's how we keep GL consistent.

Action items:
1) Olga to update billing appendix to include the invoice XML fields and sample layout (PO number field mapping).
2) Olga to propose the final term: Net45 standard; Net60 with 2% processing fee OR Net45 with 1.5% discount for 6-month prepay / 5% for 12-month prepay.
3) Sara to confirm whether AmeriMedical will accept the prepay discount or prefers the Net60 path.

I'll also toss this to Karthik for quick revenue recognition and legal sign-off on the prepay discount language.

-Marissa
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: David Lin <david.lin@amerimedical.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Holt <sara.holt@amerimedical.com>
Date: 2027-02-23T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PO template + invoicing cadence questions

Hi all,

Appreciate the fast turnaround. A couple of clarifications from Finance:

- Consolidated monthly statements are fine as long as each invoice line includes the PO number AND the invoice includes the vendor remit-to address matching our ERP vendor record.
- AmeriMedical can agree to the prepay discount structure, but we need a short window for getting internal approvals.
- If we go Net60 (no prepay), can Redwood confirm that invoices will be batched once per month (rather than weekly)? Some vendors give Net60 but force weekly billing — that defeats our consolidation.

We prefer the prepay discount if you can show a clear net cost break. If you can provide a sample monthly statement and the XML field mapping we can share with our AP automation team for quick acceptance.

Thanks,
David
Director, Finance Operations
AmeriMedical Systems

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sara Holt <sara.holt@amerimedical.com>, David Lin <david.lin@amerimedical.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-25T14:50:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PO template + invoicing cadence questions

Sara / David — thanks. Finalizing items below so we can close the commercial LoA and issue the PO: 

1) Invoice format and PO mapping: Redwood will include PO number in invoice header and populate the following XML fields: PO_NUMBER, BU_CODE, VENDOR_CODE, REMIT_TO. (sample file attached in SOW Appendix).
2) Billing cadence: Redwood will emit a single invoice file per PO once per month. If your PO contains multiple BU lines that require separate invoices, we will still emit those invoices monthly and include them in one monthly statement (one PDF statement listing invoice numbers and amounts).
3) Payment terms: Standard Net45. Option A: Net60 acceptance — requires either (a) enrollment in invoice guarantee (2% processing fee) or (b) our legal to sign explicit Net60 acceptance (we prefer alternate economic adjustment). Option B: Prepay discounts — 1.5% for 6 months prepaid; 5% for full 12 months prepaid.
4) Additional operational detail: Redwood will send the invoice XML via the secure SFTP endpoint or via your AP EDI connector (your choice).

Attached: finalized billing appendix (AMED-MSA-appendixA.pdf) and a sample monthly statement. Also linking the DocuSign quote for signatures: https://www.docusign.com/AMED-2027-07/quote.

Please reply with: (a) confirmation you accept monthly consolidated statements with invoice listing, and (b) whether AmeriMedical will take prepay discount or prefers Net60 path. Once confirmed, Sara can issue the PO and we will route contracting.

Olga Petrov
Sr. Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: AMED-MSA-appendixA.pdf, sample-monthly-statement.pdf
